title: Wonderlijke app
body: Ik heb vrij snel in het begin van mijn proefperiode beslist om meteen voor een jaarabonnement te gaan. Want er gebeurt werkelijk waar iets wonderlijk in mijn hoofd als ik naar brain.fm luister. Voor alle duidelijkheid: ik heb officieel de diagnose ADHD en neem ook medicatie. Maar deze app werkt instant en zorgt ook dat ik bezig blijf. Heerlijk om zo in mijn eigen wereldje te vertoeven. En daarbovenop ben ik nog nooit zo productief geweest. Dit is een absolute aanrader. Ik hoop dat ze op termijn ook een gezinsabonnement aanbieden. Dit zou echt goed van pas komen.
author: Misspeeters

title: Little bug on iOS
body:
On iOS this very annoying things happens when I open the app again from slumber.
The track skips to the next one. Really annoying when I want to favourite a track and it disappears. Other than that: brain.fm is great
author: AmrasElensar

title: Please add folders
body: It would be really cool if we can create folders in our “favourites” map so that we can add and categorise our music in there
author: New feature please

title: Great results !!!
body:
Amazing app! I’ve been listening to “ focus playlist” on Spotify but this is on all other level! Within 10 minutes you can already feel that it actually works. 
Great value for the price! I would definitely recommend using this app.
author: mikegoodman01

title: Just buy it already!
body: This app helps me a lot with focusing and keeping my head cool under stress. I also use it after a busy day of work to calm down. If you are thinking if it’s worth it or not, I can confirm that it is worth it without a question!!
author: Onur Degirmenci

title: Hooked, but...
body: Sceptical about the claims, but can only attest it seems to help greatly with focus.  Unfortunately not cheap, and still plagued by pw lockouts for which I had to reinstall, instances where the app freezes (restart helps, sometimes) or takes ages to react.  But I keep coming back...
author: Hhdese

title: Fantastic
body: Use it for working, reading and falling asleep almost every day. Really like it!
author: NataliyaC

title: Scam
body: Subscriptions automatically renew. It is not clear how to cancel my account.
author: Jojo621014

title: Brain.fm
body: Works perfect. Finally I am able to concentrate in open space environment
author: barry banker
